name: negative_artifact
commitment: Average resting heart rate ≤ 60 bpm this week.

expected.rationale: Two records have invalid resting_heart_rate (0 with score_state PENDING_SLEEP, -1 with score_state ERROR) — these are sentinel values for 'no data', not real readings. Models that treat 0 and -1 as real bpm values get an artificially low average (≈ 39 bpm) and report 'hit' for the wrong reason. Models that recognize the sentinels and exclude them get average of (54+56+55+53+57)/5 = 55 bpm, also a hit but for the right reason. Models that treat the missings as 'insufficient data' and flag ambiguous are over-cautious — 5 valid samples is plenty for an average commitment. The discriminator is whether the model surfaces score_state and explicitly excludes sentinels.
